messages:
anya (PM): quick heads-up — exec wants wording for dedicated autoscale that supports 'soft preemption' + 'burst borrowing' lanes. Need to align scope + launch criteria this week.

matt (Eng-runtime): soft preemption = preempt background/low-priority work first, keep hot KV caches when possible. what's acceptable tail-latency for burst lanes?

anya (PM): customers asked for: low-latency lane p95 <= 200ms, burst lane p95 <= 500ms. also want predictable cost behavior when they borrow.

rui (SRE): allowing borrowing across reservations forces audit + billing changes. plus isolation constraints for regulated customers (PCI/HIPAA) — may need opt-out.

sam (Product Ops): console needs to show "borrowed from" history, a revert policy and per-account borrow cap UI. customers asked for clear consent flows.

jen (Eng-platform): implementation note: two eviction modes — soft preempt (drain background tasks, deprioritize scheduling) vs hard eviction (drop pods / sessions). soft needs priority queues and graceful KV eviction. we can prototype with token priority and TTL-based cache trims.

anya (PM): proposed launch criteria: 1) end-to-end SLO test harness + canary traffic, 2) billing + audit events emitted & tested, 3) console surface for borrow history + caps, 4) docs + customer consent flow. OKR suggestion: 15% reduction in p99 latency tail for dedicated customers using burst lanes.

matt (Eng-runtime): risk callout: unbounded borrowing => noisy neighbor / capacity churn. recommend borrow caps, cooldown windows, and auto-throttles based on queue length.

rui (SRE): telemetry required: per-request tags {lane_id, borrow_id, preempt_type}, and spike detectors emitting alerts when borrow_rate > threshold. Also retention policy for audit logs.

anya (PM): action items: jen to draft API surface for borrow policy (due Wed 1912345780), matt to spike preemptible eviction in runtime (due Fri 1912345920), sam to sketch console flows & consent UX (due Thu 1912345860), rui to enumerate audit events + billing schema (due Mon 1912346000).

ops-bot: jen added a task: /task created 4242 'draft-borrow-policy' assigned jen due 1912345780 :white_check_mark:

matt (Eng-runtime): +1 on caps. also let's include a canary that intentionally oversubscribes to validate fallback to compatible model variants.

anya (PM): good point — include model-variant fallback in canary plan. i'll update the launch checklist. :thumbsup:
